data.gender_notes: Gehna is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gehna is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘geh’ which means ‘gold’. The name Gehna refers to the one who is as radiant and beautiful as gold. In Hindu mythology, Gehna is the name of a goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Gehna carries the meaning “Golden Splendor” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gehna usually hope their child will grow to embody golden splendor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of wealth and prosperity in Hinduism.
data.etymology: Gehna belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden Splendor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gehna total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Gehna holds cultural significance in the Indian subcontinent as it is considered an elegant and exotic name particularly for girls. Gold being a symbol of prosperity and wealth in Indian culture, the name Gehna signifies being rich in life and having a bright outlook.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, Gehna signifies the inner radiance and beauty that comes from within. It encourages one to be as pure and golden in their soul as the precious metal itself. The name can serve as a reminder to value the inner wealth and light that one possesses, rather than materialistic possessions. Additionally, as a manifestation of the goddess of wealth, Gehna can symbolize the abundance and blessings bestowed upon an individual by the divine.
